description:
Return a queued owned-job receipt (data.job_id and data.status). Read the exact id through job_service.get_job for the complete former response in job.result or the typed failure in job.error. Admission retains payload references locally; uncertain effects require reconciliation and must never be replayed automatically.

Scheduler-fired EDGE_SINK sibling that recalculates ACT-R activation strength across all memories. Terminal action; no result-processor dispatch and no inference scaffold. Cron-only wiring (`is_discoverable=False`); not surfaced via process_search. The model-callable equivalent is service_interface::memory_service::recompute_strengths.
embedding_description: Scheduler cron sibling that fires periodic ACT-R activation-strength recomputation as an EDGE_SINK terminal action. Operator wiring used only by the actr_memory daily schedule; returns updated_count without re-entering the inference scaffold. The model-callable equivalent is service_interface::memory_service::recompute_strengths.
